_note: Short task descriptions and the scoring rule of each task family, written from the released annotations and original/evaluate_utils.py. Shown in the task matrix when a row is expanded.

Geneal_criterion_QA.label: General question answering
Geneal_criterion_QA.rule: Each question is a fixed-choice or short answer. Accuracy: the cleaned answer equals the reference, or contains it without also containing any other listed option. Instruction following: the answer is one of the options the question offered. Composite = 80% accuracy + 20% instruction following.

Grounding_criterion_QA.label: Grounding
Grounding_criterion_QA.rule: The answer is a bounding box or a class plus a box. Accuracy: the predicted box overlaps the reference with IoU above 0.5. Instruction following: the answer is in the requested box format. A third component, mean IoU over all boxes, also enters the composite.

Relation_criterion_QA.label: Element relation
Relation_criterion_QA.rule: Each question asks which numbered elements a sign or light corresponds to. The answer is parsed for the numbers after 'corresponds to'. Any wrong number scores zero; otherwise credit is the fraction of reference numbers named. Accuracy and instruction following are averaged with a third relation-consistency component.

RoadSpeed_criterion_QA.label: Lane speed relation
RoadSpeed_criterion_QA.rule: Two questions per scene ask for speed limits as [min, max]. Accuracy: the parsed pair matches the reference. Instruction following: the answer is a bracketed pair. A third component rewards consistency between the paired questions.

RoadChange_criterion_QA.label: Lane change relation
RoadChange_criterion_QA.rule: Two questions per scene ask whether a lane change is allowed. Accuracy: the parsed True/False matches. Instruction following: the answer is a boolean. A third component rewards consistency between the paired questions.

Judge_criterion_QA.label: Judgment and description
Judge_criterion_QA.rule: Each scene mixes yes/no judgment questions with descriptive ones. Accuracy: descriptive answers match the reference. Instruction following: the answer is one of the offered options. A third component is the yes/no judgment accuracy. Composite weights the three.

tasks.Traffic_Light: Identify the state or type of a traffic light within the marked box.
tasks.Pavement_Marking: Name the pavement marking within the marked box.
tasks.Traffic_Sign: Read the meaning of a traffic sign within the marked box.
tasks.Right_Of_Way: Decide which road user has right of way in the scene.
tasks.VRU_Recognition: Locate pedestrians and riders with a bounding box.
tasks.Vehicle_Recognition: Locate vehicles with a bounding box.
tasks.Vehicle_Status: State a vehicle's status, such as moving, parked, or turning.
tasks.Lane_Recognition: Name the lane type the ego vehicle is in.
tasks.Obstruction_Recognition: Locate an obstruction on the road with a bounding box.
tasks.Light: State the lighting condition of the scene.
tasks.Weather: State the weather in the scene.
tasks.Sign_Sign_Relation: Say which numbered signs a given sign corresponds to.
tasks.Sign_Lane_Relation: Say which numbered lanes a sign applies to.
tasks.Light_Lane_Relation: Say which numbered lanes a traffic light governs.
tasks.Lane_Speed_Relation: Give the speed limits that apply to a lane as [min, max].
tasks.Lane_Change_Relation: Say whether a lane change is permitted here.
tasks.VRU_Cutin: Judge from a short clip whether a pedestrian or rider cuts into the ego path.
tasks.Vehicle_Cutin: Judge from a short clip whether a vehicle cuts into the ego lane.
tasks.VRU_Cross: Judge from a short clip whether a pedestrian or rider is crossing.
tasks.Long_Short_Parking: Say whether a stopped vehicle is parked for a short or long time.
tasks.Vehicle_Bahavior: Describe what a marked vehicle is doing across the clip.
tasks.VRU_Bahavior: Describe what a marked pedestrian or rider is doing across the clip.
tasks.Key_Obsturction_Detection: Judge whether an obstruction is relevant to the ego path and describe it.
tasks.Spatial_Temporal_Reasoning: Answer about motion and relative position across the clip.
tasks.Risk_Prediction: Judge the risk posed by a road user and explain it.
tasks.Drive_Efficiency: Rate how efficiently the ego vehicle is being driven.
tasks.Longitudinal: Choose the longitudinal meta-action: accelerate, maintain, decelerate, stop.
tasks.Lateral: Choose the lateral meta-action: keep straight, turn, or change lane.
tasks.Trajectory: Predict the ego trajectory; scored separately in the paper and not included here.
